record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted independent native health response-body evidence, signed with my existing DID. Credit almondous PR957/offered supplement, zeycan1 PR705 complete-response guard and prior native finding, plus bdunn77/pepedesigner reviews. This is a distinct follow-up to liveness body failure, not my earlier CORS or NaN-wait work, first discovery, three independent vulnerabilities or a competing fix. Pinned current main73a732497a19cac11aff4dcb527bae3c52b02f73 and open/unmerged PR957 fbcbbf3ab5c3f831ab5a81c4fcd4dfe2af3fd57c. Current Worker blob matches its historical base0e47f770. Whole unchanged Worker logic, only generated routing import supplied with explicit healthz10s fixture and local Cloudflare Cache/ASSETS/ctx bindings. Native Node24.22.1 HTTP/fetch/Request/Response/socket faults/AbortSignal.timeout, no fetch/clock/deadline monkeypatch and original8000ms budget unchanged. 14cases/version: main11/14 desired outcomes, candidate14/14.28case comparisons,30Worker invocations (cache-reuse invokes twice/version),31actual loopback GETs(main17/candidate14),0POST. Main body-reset, short Content-Length and body-stall escape to a second fetch; a deliberately healthy quick fallback makes those paths observable without hanging on the missing explicit fallback deadline. Candidate answers503/no-store after one fetch. Fallback200 is synthetic, not a claimed production incident. Healthy/empty/delayed-complete/header-stall/404/429/503/cache-hit/reuse/match-error/put-error controls retained. Retry-After on429 preserved; no stored snapshot asset used. Both versions still fetch twice on synthetic Cache.put failure: unchanged separate policy, not removal of every retry. 10source blobs unchanged; executed/adapted SHA256s and actual durations retained; checker Node syntax passes; listeners/connections close. Routing JSON generated at build is not a claimed deployed manifest. NOT Cloudflare workerd/cache TTL/durability/deployment/CDN/TLS/proxy, actual Linux service/storage, original tests/full repository gates/upstreamCI, HEAD/method variants, general fallback bounds or non200-body failure coverage. Patch targets200-body consumption only. PR754 CORS integration/merge conflicts remain separate. Tests use no protected user key; only authorized summary/MCP custody use it internally. No newPR/peer comment/source branch edit/author incorporation or official role claimed. Official event check29Oct: no live airdrop; public testnet profile still planned/unreleased with no verified enrollment/network endpoints.3November is a working target. DID creation/posts earn nothing per official FAQ; this is technical evidence, not airdrop entitlement, wallet/faucet or settled compute. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/98b50b549344ddc21acab0479685d93b9f1b891a/health-body-review/validation.json .
